/.title: Relyxus: incident response for regulated payments firms
/.description: Relyxus pulls logs, deploys and alerts into one incident record, ranks the likely cause with the evidence attached, holds every fix for a named approver, and drafts the DORA or UK first notice.
/.h1: Know why payments failed, before the regulator asks.
/.body: Relyxus pulls logs, changes and alerts into one record, ranks the likely cause and waits for a named approver before anything changes.

/product.title: Product
/product.description: One product, three modules: the War Room for investigation, Approvals for named sign-off, and the Command Centre for leadership.
/product.h1: One incident record, from first alert to regulator notice
/product.body: Relyxus is one product with three modules: the War Room for the investigation, Approvals for named sign-off, and the Command Centre for leadership.

/solutions/engineering.title: For payments engineering
/solutions/engineering.description: For SRE, on-call and platform teams: the alert, recent changes and the affected service in one record, with likely causes ranked and their sources attached.
/solutions/engineering.h1: Find the cause in minutes, with the evidence beside it
/solutions/engineering.body: Relyxus puts the alert, the last few hours of changes and the affected service in one record, and ranks the likely causes with their sources attached.

/solutions/resilience.title: For resilience and risk
/solutions/resilience.description: For operational resilience and compliance: every step timestamped and attributed while the incident runs, so the DORA or UK first notice starts as a draft.
/solutions/resilience.h1: The regulator notice starts at the first alert
/solutions/resilience.body: Every step is timestamped and attributed while the incident runs, so the DORA or UK first notice begins as a draft, not a blank page.

/solutions/leadership.title: For payments leadership
/solutions/leadership.description: For CTOs, COOs and Heads of Payments: money at risk, decisions waiting and the regulator clock, while the incident is happening.
/solutions/leadership.h1: Know what’s at risk, and who decided what, while it’s happening
/solutions/leadership.body: The Command Centre shows money at risk, the decisions waiting and the regulator clock, without you joining the incident call.

/pilot.title: Replay pilot
/pilot.description: Start with an incident you have already closed. We replay it read-only and show you the record Relyxus would have left.
/pilot.h1: Start with an incident you’ve already closed
/pilot.body: We replay one closed incident read-only and show you the record Relyxus would have left: the ranked cause, the approvals and the notice draft.

/dora.title: DORA and UK incident reporting: every deadline explained

/dora.body: A plain guide to the DORA major-incident deadlines and the UK regime that starts on 18 March 2027, with the rules linked so you can check every line.

/dora/checklist.title: Payments incident reporting checklist (DORA and UK)
/dora/checklist.description: A one-page checklist for DORA and UK incident reporting: what to have ready before the incident, in the first hour, and before each deadline.

/dora/checklist.body: Tick what you could show an auditor today. Every unticked line is time you would spend during a real incident.
